## Verdict: hold

Two blockers, one nitpick. The retry path looks right in the happy case, but the request-key handling changes behaviour for partial failures.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Tests | passing |
| Lint | passing |
| Acceptance criteria | 2 of 3 |

blocks.title: Retries reuse a single request key
blocks.body:
Every attempt in the loop sends the **same** key. If the first attempt times out after the operation succeeds, the retry gets deduplicated and the caller sees a failure for work that actually completed.

The ticket asks for at-least-once delivery, which this satisfies, but not for the duplicate-suppression behaviour it quietly introduces.

blocks.title: No upper bound on backoff
blocks.body: `delay *= 2` with no ceiling. With `maxAttempts: 12` the last wait is over an hour.

blocks.title: New type is not exported from the barrel file
blocks.body: Everything else in this directory is re-exported from `index.ts`. Probably an oversight.
